lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu4Co8Si8 (reduced formula Eu(CoSi)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 194), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Si each adopt tetrahedral coordination, with Co surrounded by four Si neighbors and Si by four Co neighbors, while Eu centers have 16 geometric neighbors (8 Co and 8 Si). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co tetrahedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Eu and Si polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Eu and Co polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
